preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or an authorized address

exploit_hint: As the contract owner or authorized address, call the cSb() function with a high percentage (e.g., 100) to drain all BNB from the contract to the tfU address (which can be set to attacker's address via setrecadd()). Alternatively, use approvals() to transfer BNB to krhF, mdhS, wthT, and extR addresses (which can also be set to attacker-controlled addresses).
